purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - monthly billing detail preview/print main program for the JMA ORCA medical practice management system
purpose.summary: ORCRRECEMAIN is the main program for generating monthly medical insurance receipt (レセプト) billing detail documents in the JMA ORCA system. It initializes the environment, opens a database, parses command parameters, and orchestrates calls to subprograms for receipt data retrieval and output. It handles inpatient/outpatient distinctions and insurance type branching.

notable_features: 157 CALL statements indicating heavy subprogram delegation
UNSTRING of comma-delimited COMMAND-PARAM for argument passing
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM PIC X(2000)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary DB abstraction (MCPDATA.INC)
SPA-AREA (scratchpad area) pattern typical of ORCA
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments. Content is clearly the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 122777 bytes (2775 lines total), but enough is visible to classify confidently.
